name: wiki_pageviews
notes: Daily EN Wikipedia pageviews for crisis/hope articles (collective attention). No key.
caveats: Pageview counts are spiky (news-driven) and subject to Wikimedia bot-filtering/traffic changes over time; article set is a hand-picked crisis/hope basket (selection-dependent); the derived index (log1p -> per-article z -> average within category) lives in analysis code (2026-07-20-11), not in this file.
